definitions.ask: Should a typed `p:<N>` fail with a teaching error once `$<N>` replaces it?

choices.label: Usage error `retired_priority_marker` teaching `$<N>`; never captured as text
`p:<N>` keeps working as a silent synonym; docs teach only `$<N>`
`p:<N>` becomes ordinary task text with no diagnostic

definitions.why: Muscle memory and saved templates would silently become task text; matches retired `:` notes

definitions.ask: Should `\$` / `\$<N>` keep a trailing dollar amount as literal task text?
definitions.why: Trailing amounts (`Venmo Alex $3`) are common; `\&foo:bar` already sets the precedent

definitions.ask: Should the glossary `schedule-log` strand name `$<N>` instead of `p:<N>`?
definitions.corrects: or when `bob capture` uses `p:<N>`, we add a `SCHEDULE LOG` bullet
